newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down as blue chips tumble.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down as blue chips tumble.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Thursday as blue chips tumbled on profit-taking on being offloaded by weak holders before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 3.48 points, or 0.21 percent, down at 1,639.28 with 147 losers and 132 gainers. Volume fell to 49 million shares from Wednesday's 57 million.
The index dived by some 30 points at midday after a slide in bell-wether PTCL and HUBCO stocks, but was lifted by fresh buying in the two stocks before the close, one dealer said.
The stocks are likely to open mixed on Sunday, he said.
PTCL dipped 1.85 rupees to 33.15, HUBCO 0.90 to 39.10, Dewan Salman 1.40 to 41.20, Faysal Bank 0.25 to 28.25 and Adamjee Insurance 2.00 to 106.
PSO rose 2.00 to 300, Citicorp Investment Bank 2.20 to 30 and Orix Leasing 1.00 to 51.
